item.title: US stocks drop after Trump ramps up his tariffs and investors dump potential AI losers
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — U.S. stocks slumped Monday after President Donald Trump ramped up his newest tariffs, while investors continued to punish companies that could be losers in the artificial-intelligence revolution.

item.title: Data shows which areas of state have the most millionaires
item.description: OLYMPIA — In pitching their proposed income tax on households earning more than $1 million a year, Gov. Bob Ferguson and Democrats argue that relatively few Washingtonians would be made to pay.

item.title: Flights canceled at Sea-Tac amid East Coast blizzard, Mexico violence
item.description: Dozens of flights were canceled and delayed at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Monday morning, amid severe weather on the East Coast and violence in Mexico.

item.title: More than 30,000 Kaiser Permanente health care workers to end strike in California and Hawaii
item.description: LOS ANGELES — An estimated 31,000 registered nurses and other front-line Kaiser Permanente health care workers will return to work on Tuesday after a four-week strike in California and Hawaii to demand better wages and staffing.

item.title: Volunteers scour the desert for Nancy Guthrie despite authorities urging them to stop
item.description: TUCSON, Ariz. — The disappearance of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie’s mother three weeks ago has inspired a small number of volunteers to launch their own searches in the dense desert near her home in hopes of cracking the case.

item.title: ICE officer training is ‘deficient’ and ‘broken,’ former agency lawyer tells congressional forum
item.description: WASHINGTON — A former U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement lawyer who was responsible for training new deportation officers warned Monday that the agency's training program for new recruits is “deficient, defective and broken.”

item.title: WA Senate leaders propose $1.5 billion for transportation work
item.description: The state Senate’s top Democratic and Republican transportation leaders joined hands Monday to propose $1.5 billion in new spending, mainly for safety and maintenance.

item.title: Frozen meatballs recalled nationwide over possible metal contamination
item.description: If you have a bag of frozen meatballs tucked away for an easy weeknight dinner, federal officials say it’s time to check the label.
